allowed: V21 anonymous combine, unary-router, and interaction programs
paired counter cancellation by decrementing both nonempty channels
forbidden: host division or Fraction in learner code
the words reciprocal, field, or linear equation during candidate search

searches.candidate_space: source routing and direction policies over cancelled magnitude, source denominator, one, and zero
searches.selection_objective: representation-invariant nonzero unary behavior whose interaction with its input yields the anonymous interaction identity and whose double application restores the input class

searches.candidate_space: all variable permutations, three unary choices per leaf, two binary choices per join, and both binary tree bracketings
searches.selection_objective: the resulting value makes the registered three-input relation replay exactly on all development probes

success_conditions: exactly one behavior class satisfies the nonzero unary objective
the unary behavior is proved for every nonzero directed rational equivalence class
the promoted operations satisfy all commutative-field obligations
the three-input program is discovered without a target expression and is proved sound and unique whenever the first input is nonzero
all single-route mutations receive concrete counterexamples
hidden values outside the search grid replay exactly
learner execution uses natural counters only
failure_conditions: multiple inequivalent behaviors pass without a discriminating experiment
any zero input is silently assigned a nonzero-unary result
representation scaling or common offsets change the result class
a finite probe is presented as the universal proof
an evaluator Fraction or human arithmetic name enters learner search
